chronology.notes: Chron uses top, 5 radiocarbon dates, and estimated date of deglaciation.
Chron uses top and radiocarbon dates calibrated with CALIB 4.4. Calibrated dates are the 50% median probability.

Based on IntCal13 calibration curve. Estimated time of deglaciation set to prevent unrealistic extrapolation. Hiatus set at 291.5 cm to allow kink in accumulation rate.
